title: Where Are the Nine
speaker: Pastor Wayne Holcomb
description:
Where Are the Nine | gratitude, obedience, saving faith, and God's mercy - Luke 17:11-19

Gratitude is the mark of a heart that truly sees the mercy of God. In Luke 17:11-19, ten lepers cry out to Jesus, and all ten are cleansed as they obey His word and go. Yet only one turns back, falls at His feet, glorifies God, and gives thanks. The question still searches us: "Where are the nine?"

Jesus meets us in our need, but He does not call us to a casual faith. He calls us to rise, trust, obey, and return to Him with thankful hearts. So often we cry out in crisis, receive His help, and drift back into life as usual. But real blessing is not only in being helped — it is in knowing Him, honoring Him, and walking in relationship with Him.

Life is fragile, and today is the day to come to Christ. If we have Jesus, we have everything that matters: forgiveness, cleansing, peace, and eternal life.
